title.suggested: Sullivan declines match with Zachritz, backed by Allen's former backer

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Globe-Democrat reported that John L. Sullivan, fearing Missouri's prize-fighting laws, refused Tom Kelly's proposal to match Fred Zachritz against him; Zachritz was backed by a doctor and a former backer of Tom Allen.

metadata.notes: Masthead: St. Louis Daily Globe-Democrat, Thursday Morning, November 8, 1883.

notes: Current title ('Tom Allen in Prize Fight') is wrong; Allen is mentioned only as the former client of one of Zachritz's backers.
